name: PyTorch Certified Associate

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes one retake and 12 months to schedule. The $299 PTCA Certification Pathway adds four self-paced modules; a bundle with the THRIVE-ONE annual subscription costs $495.

exam.format: Online, proctored multiple-choice exam, 120 minutes. No prerequisites.

access.retake: One free retake is included if the first attempt is not passed; it must be taken within the 12 months of eligibility that start at purchase, with no enforced wait beyond scoring (up to 24 hours) and the 24-hour booking lead time.
access.accommodations: Candidates with disabilities send the Test Accommodations Form at least two weeks before the exam, before scheduling it; requests are reviewed case by case.

scope: Fundamentals, model development, performance/optimization and data handling.
caveats: Length conflict: the PTCA certification and pathway pages give 120 minutes, but the Linux Foundation multiple-choice FAQ and instructions linked from them still say every multiple-choice exam except the CNPA lasts 90 minutes with 60 questions. The 120 minutes are used here and no question count is listed. The 75% pass mark comes from that FAQ, which applies it to all multiple-choice exams.

prep.title: Linux Foundation: PTCA Certification Pathway
prep.note: Four self-paced modules aligned with the PTCA domains (LFD2000–LFD2003) plus the exam, $299.
